crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Large, high-contrast white patch covering the crown and nape, tapering toward the mantle.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Extremely sharp and linear boundary between the white nape patch and the dark dorsal plumage.

other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical white patches on the lateral scapular regions flanking a dark central dorsal stripe.
